warnings: Explicit unverified local candidate diagnostic, not a reviewed montage or certified sync.
Template cosine is not probability; local profile and gameplay/outcomes are uncalibrated.
Context inferred locally only; scene cuts, fight closure and song suitability remain unverified.
authored_role_scope: Generated video design roles only, not reviewed gameplay semantics.
candidate_protection: Every root attack retained; bridge/fade exclude all intervals with >=0.18s margin.

local_selection_evidence.policy: Existing associated audio only; full root candidates, no truncation, reuse, outcome claims or filler.

pacing.grid_origin: measured acoustic attacks from hit-map/v1, unreviewed
pacing.selection: max rows beat-matched, then max total slow-motion, under per-row and duration budgets

rigid_rows.reason: no certified stretch fits this row at its drifted position; rendered rigid at 1x with its offset reported, nothing force-fitted

limitations: Candidate pacing only: anchors are unreviewed local acoustic/video candidates, not reviewed shots or kills.
The target grid is measured acoustic attacks, not certified percussion, meter or musical taste.
Playback is slowed only in the gaps between measured burst clusters; each cluster keeps rigid 1x playback so gunshot transients are not smeared.
Gap slow-motion cannot go below the engine's atempo range, so the declared floor stays at or above 0.5 with a small margin for rounded slice edges.
No interval is ever sped up: gaps keep 1x or stretch, bounded by the declared slow floor and per-row budget.
Gap capacity is the inverse of the same analytic C2 bound the map certifies with, so no gap can overshoot the floor.
Clusters and rows without a reachable measured attack stay at 1x and are reported as unsnapped/rigid; nothing is force-fitted or invented.
musical_sync remains unverified; no lyric/closure integration exists for retimed clocks.
